 Print IIT Kharagpur The Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) will close the registration window for the Joint Admission Test for Masters (JAM) 2027 today, October 22. Candidates who wish to apply for postgraduate programmes in science and related fields at Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) and other participating institutes must complete their applications before the deadline. Interested candidates can submit their forms online through the official website, jam.iitkgp.ac.in. Those who have not yet registered should complete the process and pay the required application fee before the window closes. IIT JAM 2027 exam date and schedule
 IIT Kharagpur will conduct JAM 2027 on February 14 in computer-based test (CBT) mode. The examination will take place in two sessions. The morning session will be held from 9:30 am to 12:30 pm for Chemistry (CY), Geology (GG) and Mathematics (MA). The afternoon session will take place from 2:30 pm to 5:30 pm for Biotechnology (BT), Economics (EN), Mathematical Statistics (MS) and Physics (PH). Candidates can appear for one or two test papers. However, those choosing two papers must select subjects scheduled in different sessions. The question paper will include Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs), Multiple Select Questions (MSQs) and Numerical Answer Type (NAT) questions. IIT JAM 2027 : How to apply
 Candidates can follow these steps to complete the registration process: Visit the official website, jam.iitkgp.ac.in.
 Click on the application portal link.
 Select the registration option and enter the required details.
 Log in using the enrolment ID or email address and password.
 Fill out the application form with personal and academic details.
 Upload the required documents in the prescribed format.
 Pay the application fee.
 Check all the details entered in the form and submit the application.
 Download the confirmation receipt and keep it for future reference.
 Direct link here. Candidates should ensure that they complete the application process today to avoid missing the deadline. IIT JAM 2027: Programmes and admission details
 JAM 2027 will offer admission to 89 postgraduate programmes across 23 IITs for the 2027-28 academic session. The programmes include Master of Science (MSc), Master of Science in Technology (MSc Tech), Master of Science by Research (MS Research), MSc-MTech programmes, Joint MSc-PhD programmes, MSc-PhD dual degrees and integrated PhD programmes.
